_comment: SHIPPED DEFAULT: no approved fashion prices exist yet. Every fashion material is 'unconfigured', so the API returns pricing_status=unavailable and Add to Bag stays disabled. This is intentional (spec section 6): fixed 1 cm3 volume is confirmed, but the CPP formula also needs reference bounding-box dimensions, and no reference dimensions or fixed price table have been approved. Replace this file (or point P3_PRICING_PROFILE elsewhere) with an approved profile. See docs/PRICING.md.
